Overview.Name: Susmitha Veerni
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Paneer cubes (100 g) & vegetable salad
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & chicken curry (120 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs)
Option 3: paneer cubes (80 g) & vegetable salad

Notes_and_Tips: Start every meal with chicken, eggs or paneer before eating rice to naturally reduce portions.
Avoid fried outside food during stress or late nights.
Because shifts can disturb hunger signals, try to keep your 2 meals at consistent times daily.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support fat loss.
With consistency expect steady fat loss and improved body shape over the next 10–12 weeks.
